title: Repair PR6319 pinned-byte reads for multiline paths and Git context
body:
## Change
Repairs the **two already recorded intake failures** of PR #6319 at `b1cb8b91a7213d639da117a5ef3060afecd5058b`: LF-containing Git filenames can disappear from line-framed blob requests, and inherited `GIT_DIR` can redirect the requested root to a clean repository.

The proposed guard is absent from current main, so this adds its original implementation and six byte-identical predecessor tests with credit retained, plus the minimal repairs:
- CR/LF paths use literal NUL-framed tree lookup followed by a checked blob-OID read; ordinary paths retain batching.
- Git reads reuse the existing shared `git_source_env()` policy.
- Ten independent bare-object CLI regressions cover exact path bytes, classification, root redirection and failed reads.

Pin states, frozen-prefix policy and advisory/strict exit behavior are unchanged. No new digest formats, automatic guard gate, mathematical admission or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence
Python 3.12.14: all **6 original + 10 new tests** pass normally and optimized. The same new suite against the authenticated original produces **29 failing subcases in each mode**; these reproduce the known failure families, not 29 newly discovered bugs. A read-only source copy passes with Git explicitly admitted. Committed bytes/modes and the self-contained source export were checked.

Reproduce the four commands in [the scope note](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/170867c0a8f92375dfc489dd090bad5daee7b090/docs/research/pinned-edit-source-reads.md). The new regression filename matches the existing CI discovery rule; no workflow changes. Hosted CI and maintainer acceptance remain separate.

## Task, scope and credit
Donation card `portable-replay`, **changed scope** to the two named static source-context comparison failures. Canonical main refreshed unchanged at `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority8, selected6030 unchanged. Fresh 322-open-PR pagination, exact source head and canonical intake decision checked; bounded overlap is not novelty proof. [Canonical repair claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/6356).

Original guard/tests: Armin Pourshafeie / apoursh with substantial Claude Code / Anthropic assistance. The intake reviewer supplied both counterexamples. Credit Arham Tahir / PR1595, Douglas Colkitt, the shared Git-source environment policy's T74-2530 lineage, Sagar Thakrar and ywz65. New repairs and independent regressions: ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and three bounded agents.

Next: independently review these exact changes and decide integration alongside PR6319. Broader guard admission and automatic gating remain maintainer decisions. No PR closure or merge; maintainer edits disabled.
